# QIIME 2 Data Export Pipeline

This script reads QIIME 2 artifacts (.qza files) and exports formatted tables for manuscript supplementary material.

## Load Required Libraries

```{r load-libraries}
rm(list = ls())
library(tidyverse)
library(biomformat)
library(jsonlite)
library(glue)
library(qiime2R)
```

## Helper Functions



## Configuration

```{r config}
# Set your file paths here
root_dir <- "~/projects/microbiome/workflow_results"  
output_dir <- "~/projects/microbiome/documents/supplementary_tables"


# Create output directory if it doesn't exist
if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) {
  dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}

# QIIME 2 artifact file paths
taxonomy_qza <- file.path(root_dir, "taxonomy_classification/taxonomy.qza")

table_qza_orig <- file.path(root_dir, "artifacts/table.qza")
evenness_qza_orig <- file.path(root_dir, "artifacts/diversities/evenness_vector.qza")
faith_pd_qza_orig <- file.path(root_dir, "artifacts/diversities/faith_pd_vector.qza")
unifrac_qza_orig <- file.path(root_dir, "artifacts/diversities/weighted_unifrac_distance_matrix.qza")

table_qza_gcn <- file.path(root_dir, "branch_raspergade/table-corrected.qza")
evenness_qza_gcn <- file.path(root_dir, "branch_raspergade/diversities/evenness_vector.qza")
faith_pd_qza_gcn <- file.path(root_dir, "branch_raspergade/diversities/faith_pd_vector.qza")
unifrac_qza_gcn <- file.path(root_dir, "branch_raspergade/diversities/weighted_unifrac_distance_matrix.qza")

# Metadata file with subject-id and sample-id
metadata_file <- file.path(root_dir, "../input_data/meta_data.tsv")
```

## Read and Process Data

### 1. Feature Table with Taxonomy

```{r read-table-taxonomy}

export_count_table <- function(tbl_qza,tax_qza,outdir,name){
  cat("\nReading feature table...\n")
  ft <- read_qza(tbl_qza)
  
  # Create feature table dataframe
  feature_df <- as.data.frame(ft$data) %>%
    rownames_to_column("feature_id") %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = -feature_id,
      names_to = "sample_id",
      values_to = "count"
    ) 
  
  cat("Reading taxonomy...\n")
  taxonomy <- read_qza(tax_qza)$data
  
  # Ensure column names are correct (adjust if your taxonomy file has different names)
  # Common column names: "Feature ID", "Taxon", "taxonomy", etc.
  colnames(taxonomy)[1] <- "feature_id"
  colnames(taxonomy)[2] <- "taxonomy"
  
  # Combine feature table with taxonomy
  feature_taxonomy <- feature_df %>%
    left_join(taxonomy, by = "feature_id")
  
  write_csv(feature_taxonomy,file.path(outdir,name))
  
  cat(glue("\nexported: Table counts to {file.path(outdir,name)}"))
  cat(glue("\nFeature table: {nrow(feature_df)} observations across {n_distinct(feature_df$sample_id)} samples\n"))
  
}

export_count_table(table_qza_orig,taxonomy_qza,output_dir,"ORIG_Feature_Counts_with_Taxonomy.csv")
export_count_table(table_qza_gcn,taxonomy_qza,output_dir,"GCN_Feature_Counts_with_Taxonomy.csv")

```

### 2. Alpha Diversity Metrics

```{r read-alpha-diversity}
export_alpha_div <- function(evenness_qza,faith_pd_qza,metadata_file, outdir,name) {
  cat("Reading alpha diversity metrics...\n")
  
  metadata <- read_tsv(metadata_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    rename("sample_id"="sample-id")

  # Read evenness
  evenness <- read_qza(evenness_qza)$data %>% rownames_to_column("sample_id")
  colnames(evenness)[2] <- "Evenness"
  evenness <- evenness %>% select(sample_id, Evenness)
  
  # Read Faith's PD
  faith_pd <- read_qza(faith_pd_qza)$data %>% rownames_to_column("sample_id")
  if(length(colnames(faith_pd))==3){
    colnames(faith_pd)[1] <- "_t"
    colnames(faith_pd)[2] <- "sample_id"
    colnames(faith_pd)[3] <- "FaithPD"
  }else{
    colnames(faith_pd)[2] <- "FaithPD"
  }
  faith_pd <- faith_pd %>% select(sample_id, FaithPD)
  # Combine alpha diversity metrics
  alpha_diversity <- evenness %>%
    left_join(faith_pd, by = "sample_id") %>% 
    left_join(metadata, by = "sample_id") 
  
  write_csv(alpha_diversity,file.path(outdir,name))

  cat(glue("Alpha diversity: {nrow(alpha_diversity)} samples\n"))
}

export_alpha_div(evenness_qza_orig,faith_pd_qza_orig,metadata_file, output_dir,"ORIG_Alpha_Diversity_Metrics.csv")
export_alpha_div(evenness_qza_gcn,faith_pd_qza_gcn,metadata_file, output_dir,"GCN_Alpha_Diversity_Metrics.csv")
```

```{r}
# merge differentially abundant taxonomic ranks

export_da <- function(input_dir, pattern,outdir,name){
    files <- list.files(input_dir, pattern = pattern, full.names = TRUE)
    
    if (length(files) == 0) {
      stop("No files found matching pattern: ", pattern)
    }
    
    cat("Found", length(files), "files:\n")
    print(basename(files))
    
    # Function to extract taxonomic rank from filename
    extract_rank <- function(fname) {
      str_extract(basename(fname), "(?<=linDA_).*(?=_Sig_LFC1\\.csv)")
    }
    
    # Read, clean, select columns, and combine
    merged_data <- map_dfr(files, ~ {
      rank_name <- extract_rank(.x)
      
      read_csv(.x, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
        # Rename visit column
        rename(time_point = visit) %>%
        # Recode specific time_point values
        mutate(time_point = case_when(
          time_point == "v7" ~ "1-week EP395",
          time_point == "v8" ~ "2-week EP395",
          TRUE               ~ time_point
        )) %>%
        # Add taxonomic rank as first column
        mutate(Taxonomic_Rank = rank_name, .before = 1) 
    })
    
    merged_data <- merged_data %>%
        # Select only the requested columns (in this order)
        select(
          Taxonomic_Rank,
          taxa,
          time_point,
          baseMean,
          log2FoldChange,
          lfcSE,
          stat,
          pvalue,
          padj,
          reject,
          df,
          Taxon
        )
    # Export
    output_file = file.path(outdir,name)
    write_csv(merged_data, output_file)
    
    cat("\nMerged and cleaned file saved to:", output_file, "\n")
    cat("Total rows:", nrow(merged_data), "\n")
    cat("Unique taxonomic ranks:", paste(unique(merged_data$Taxonomic_Rank), collapse = ", "), "\n")
    cat("Unique time points:", paste(unique(merged_data$time_point), collapse = ", "), "\n")
}

export_da(file.path(root_dir,"/branch_raspergade/export"),
          "linDA_.*_Sig_LFC1\\.csv",
          output_dir,"GCN_inDA_merged_all_ranks_Sig_LFC1.csv")
```
